import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    si=None
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1: si=i; break
    top=g[:si]; bot=g[si+1:]
    h=min(len(top),len(bot)); w=min(len(top[0]),len(bot[0]))
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for r in top for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if top[i][j]==bot[i][j] else bg for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    o=f(G[k+' input']); exp=G[k+' output']
    print(k, o==exp)
    if o!=exp:
        dd=[(i,j,o[i][j],exp[i][j]) for i in range(len(o)) for j in range(len(o[0])) if o[i][j]!=exp[i][j]]
        print(dd[:10])
